up: From the ChEMBL database, locate the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1140610'. Then retrieve all distinct molecules that are associated with that document via compound records. For each such molecule, output the following fields: molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name (pref_name), maximum phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES. Include molecules even if some of these fields contain NULL values (for example, if a molecule lacks a SMILES entry). Do not apply any additional filters beyond the document identifier.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    md.max_phase,
    md.molecule_type,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs
JOIN compound_records ON docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON compound_records.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1140610';
